why_relevant: Practical workaround while bankassoc-kos.com blocks automated fetching: the association's verified social channel mirrors its announcements and event coverage with dates and named participants.

The only Kosovo outlet specialised exclusively in economic/financial journalism (founded 2018 by Mehmet Gjata and Agon Sinanaj). Publishes recurring pieces on bank net profit, loan/deposit interest rates, BQK indicators and inflation, frequently quoting BQK data and bank statements before they surface in English. Highest-value sq media source for A1 disclosure/earnings signals.

Albanian-language Kosovo portal dedicated to business/economy; carries bank profitability rankings, new market-entrant stories (e.g. Albanian banks targeting the Kosovo market) and commercial-bank commentary. Useful early carrier of competitive-move and product-launch signals.

Largest-traffic Albanian-language news portal in Kosovo. Reliably republishes BQK announcements (new regulations, consumer warnings on payment fraud) and bank net-profit reporting within hours; also has tag pages ('ekonomia e Kosovës') that work as ready-made topical feeds.

Koha Ditore's digital arm, among the most editorially serious Kosovo outlets. Its economy tag aggregates banking-sector, BQK and fiscal coverage; historically strong on documents obtained from institutions, which makes it a useful pointer to primary papers.

Established Kosovo daily/portal whose economy desk produces aggregate banking-results pieces (e.g. record bank profits 2024, income vs net profit, average lending/deposit rates, count of foreign vs domestic banks) drawn from BQK data.

Investigative-leaning Kosovo portal that publishes bank league-table pieces (largest banks by assets) and profit-swing stories; investigative angle makes it a likely first publisher of leaked or FOI-obtained supervisory/financial documents.

National TV broadcaster with a dedicated finance vertical; TV interviews with bank CEOs and BQK governors often carry statements (pricing, product roadmaps, executive changes) that never appear in written releases.

Wire-style Kosovo news agency; agency copy is the mechanism by which bank and BQK press releases propagate to all other sq outlets, so it is a good single upstream capture point for 'njoftim për media' texts.

High-reach sq portal; observed carrying fintech/e-money product-launch coverage in Kosovo (e.g. OneFor digital financial services app licensed by BQK as a non-bank financial institution) — exactly the payments-launch signal class this cell must catch.

Pristina-based sq digital outlet launched 2022 (Media Group Publico, owned by Berat Buzhala); part of the sq news layer that carries bank and BQK stories. Ownership concentration is a bias factor to record, not a reason to skip.

Long-running Albanian-language daily with an economy feed covering banks, central-bank statistics and government economic policy; adds redundancy for release capture and occasionally different bank sourcing.

source_name: Radio Evropa e Lirë — Kosovo economy desk (sq)
why_relevant: RFE/RL's Albanian service produces the most explanatory sq coverage of BQK regulatory decisions (e.g. the euro-only payments regulation and its fallout) and of foreign investment into Kosovo banks. Editorially independent, well-sourced, and cross-links to Serbian-language service for the north-Kosovo angle.

Albanian-language news aggregator with a Kosovo-filtered economy stream. Single best snowball surface for discovering sq outlets not yet on our list and for near-real-time monitoring across dozens of portals at once.

Kosovo think-tank publishing short sq data notes that turn BQK figures into time series (e.g. net profit of commercial banks 2015-2024). These notes are commonly the piece that sq media then quote, so GAP is both a signal and an upstream pointer to the underlying BQK dataset.

Leading Kosovo economic research institute; its sq reports and forums on the banking sector (interest-rate formation, NPLs, banks as enabler vs barrier to business) supply the analytical frame that sq media reuse and often contain bank-level detail not in BQK aggregates.

Kosovo sq analysis/commentary platform that publishes longer-form essays on the banking sector (e.g. how Kosovo's banks survived two global crises). Useful for interpretive context and for identifying named analysts to track as recurring sources.

Albanian-language outlet focused on northern Kosovo, where banking/payments coverage overlaps with the euro-vs-dinar payments question and branch access in Serb-majority municipalities. Carries BQK regulation stories with a north-Kosovo angle absent from Pristina desks.

Commercial sq comparison site listing advertised loan interest rates by Kosovo bank (ProCredit, TEB, Raiffeisen etc.). Reveals bank pricing moves faster than any published disclosure, making it an indirect early indicator of competitive repricing.
